component.name: Smudgy
component.summary: Play text-based MUDs with scripting and automapping

description.p: Smudgy is a modern client for text-based Multi-User Dungeons (MUDs). It pairs a fast terminal with an embedded JavaScript/TypeScript scripting engine, automapping, and configurable triggers, aliases, and hotkeys.
Scripts run in a sandboxed Deno runtime with per-package permissions, and maps, profiles, and packages can sync through the optional Smudgy cloud.

This package enables bounded Web Audio for scripted accessibility earcons. It is configured to attempt shared physical output and uses time-advancing silent emulation when compatible output is unavailable; see the Web Audio support page for current platform evidence and limitations.
